hero.title: A national institute for youth skills and certification
hero.description: The National Youth Training Institute designs training programmes, sets assessment standards, authorizes training partners and maintains the national registry of the certificates it issues.

mission: To empower individuals with practical skills, quality training, and recognized certification that support education, employment, entrepreneurship, and lifelong learning.
vision: A nation where every young person can access quality training and hold a credential that is recognized, trusted and verifiable.
objectives: Expand access to quality vocational and professional training for young people nationwide.
Maintain consistent training and assessment standards across online and offline delivery.
Issue certificates that are trusted by employers and verifiable by anyone.
Build a network of authorized partners that brings training closer to communities.
Support employment, self-employment and entrepreneurship through practical skills.

standards.title: Training Standards
standards.body: Programmes are mapped to competency standards and reviewed annually with industry advisors.

standards.title: Certification
standards.body: Certificates are issued only after verified completion of training and a moderated assessment.

standards.title: Authorized Partner Network
standards.body: Partners are authorized after document review and a site inspection, and are audited regularly.
